h: Rudeboy says social media has changed how fans admire artistes
p: Singer Rudeboy (Paul Okoye) has reportedly said fans no longer faint over artistes the way they once did because social media has made stars more familiar. He also spoke about how his multiple roles as producer, writer and singer eased his move into a solo career after the Psquare split.
more: He said he was already producing and writing before the split.
The comments have been shared widely by music fans.
